analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation six-pointer between 15th and 16th. Excelsior have lost five league games in a row, including 0-9 to Twente, and failed to score in two games; Telstar are more lively, beating Utrecht 4-2 and coming back at Fortuna from set pieces, with Tyrone Owusu named Player of the Month for October.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. I lean lower: Excelsior have not scored in two games and will be wary after the 0-9, and games this close to the drop zone tend to be cagey. Telstar's set pieces are the likeliest source of goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. Telstar's set-piece focus makes each corner dangerous but does not obviously add more of them; I keep the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards. I lean higher: two teams in the bottom four with a lot riding on the result, and Excelsior's Nesto Groen showed the side's nerves with a red card inside five minutes at Twente.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots. Both teams have created little lately apart from Telstar's good week, so I agree with the figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.9 shots on target. Given Excelsior's blunt attack and a likely tight game, I lean a little lower.
